OmniEdu Dataset
	

Instruction data for K–12 learning and teaching
Paper · Project Page · GitHub · Models · Quick Start · Citation
OmniEdu is a capability-oriented instruction-tuning dataset for educational models that connect subject knowledge, curriculum understanding, learner diagnosis, and instructional support. This repository releases 69,999 training examples, combining 60,951 education-specific examples with 9,048 general-purpose examples.
